prs.title: feat(serve): provision the PR watch's deps and deliver on resume
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The daemon's PR-state watch had two declared dependency seams that nothing in production ever populated, so even with the feature enabled it could neither observe nor deliver. This provisions both, and adds the one path that makes delivery prompt rather than eventual.

The observation and the drain are built over a single watch directory and a single lock registry, so the owner's in-process locks stay authoritative for every file. The allowed host set is `github.com`, the hosts in the daemon's own `gh` configuration, and the web origin of each GitHub channel this daemon hosts — taken only from the workspace groups the channel grouping already attributed to a trusted workspace, so an untrusted workspace's settings can never widen it. A `gh` read failure degrades to the rest of the set, never to an empty set that would silently disable every view. The set is recomputed when the hosted channels change rather than frozen at startup.

Waking a dormant recipient maps the shared restore's typed outcomes: the Gone set becomes `gone`, everything else `unavailable`, with a writer conflict deliberately temporary because another process may release it. A successful wake hands back a release that detaches the client the restore minted — the restore only cleans up on failure, and an in-process wake has no HTTP client to do it later, so without this the session keeps a phantom attachment and never idle-closes. It detaches rather than kills, because killing would drop the turn the drain just admitted. The wake shares the routes' session-id admission instance and their live-conversation materialize function, so it cannot restore over a reservation the routes hold, and it can restore the same sessions they can.

The self-push ledger reads the recipient's own autofix watch state, accepted only when both the repository and the session match. An untrusted primary gets no ledger at all — the lookup returns before any git runs in its checkout. Any refusal means no ledger, so the transition delivers: a missing ledger over-delivers rather than suppressing a real external head change.

Finally, a user's load or resume now fires a route-side seam that drains that workspace immediately instead of waiting for the next tick. It runs on the refresh timer's own drain state, so it sees the in-flight marks and cannot deliver twice, and it sits behind the same off switch and the same trust filter the periodic tick applies. Its coverage is declared partial on purpose: only one workspace is scanned, so every other workspace's bindings are absent from the rows, and a complete scan would let the drain delete their watch files as unbound.

The switch stays off, so nothing here runs in production yet.

## Why it's needed

The watch's delivery half was unreachable: the drain existed and was tested, but no production code supplied its dependencies, and the resume path had no way to ask for delivery. Provisioning the seams is what makes the rest of the increment mean anything, and the resume hook removes the wait between a user reopening a session and seeing its pull-request events.

These land together because the provisioning supplies the consumers the resume hook needs. Split apart, each half would ship a seam nothing sets.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run from the repository root; each command enters the package itself, and the ambient serve variables must be unset or the suites false-red:

```
cd packages/cli && env -u QWEN_CODE_SERVE -u QWEN_SERVE_MCP_BUDGET_MODE npx vitest run src/serve/server/ src/serve/fast-path.test.ts src/serve/run-qwen-serve.pr-watch-shutdown.test.ts
cd packages/cli && env -u QWEN_CODE_SERVE -u QWEN_SERVE_MCP_BUDGET_MODE npx vitest run src/serve/process-env-guard.test.ts --testTimeout=120000
```

The second command needs the longer budget: that guard walks the whole serve tree and takes about 16 seconds, just over this package's default 15-second test timeout, so it false-reds under load without it.

The startup bundle closure gate is the one that matters most for a change like this, because the new module must stay out of the pre-listen static closure. It is not a unit test — it builds and bundles, then checks the real metafile:

```
npm run check:serve-fast-path-bundle
```

It reports `Startup bundle closure checks passed.` on this head.

Eighteen mutations, each killed by its own case, with a log-wording control surviving. All were run on this head and the source restored byte-for-byte:

| Seam | Mutation | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| gh hosts | not added to the allowed set | only the allowed-set case |
| hosted origins | not added | only the allowed-set case |
| origin shape | normalise the origin URL instead of its hostname | only the allowed-set case |
| `github.com` seed | removed | only the allowed-set case |
| Gone mapping | disabled | only the Gone case |
| the release | does not detach the minted client | only the release case |
| admission classification | not a channel turn | only the admission case |
| untrusted-primary guard | removed | only the no-git case |
| ledger session check | removed | only the other-session case |
| ledger repository check | removed | only the other-repository case |
| scan partial flag | dropped | only the scan case |
| liveness | always true | the two liveness cases |
| drain lock registry | drain gets its own | the two registry cases |
| injected lock registry | ignored | only the injected-registry case |
| wake preconditions | removed | only the unavailable case |
| resume drain off switch | removed | only the switch-off case |
| resume drain trust filter | removed | only the untrusted-workspace case |
| resume drain coverage | declared complete | only the orphan-watch-file case |
| control | log wording only | all green (15 passed) |

Typecheck (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli`), ESLint and Prettier are clean.

**Verification surface, stated explicitly:** the whole `src/serve/` tree was run, not just the directory the new code lives in — 453 files, 19240 tests. That breadth was necessary: the process-env guard lives in `serve/`, not `serve/server/`, and it caught an unregistered `process.env` access that the narrower run missed. Of 15 failures on that tree, 10 are this machine's global git pre-push hook rejecting temporary remotes, 4 are load timeouts that pass in isolation with a longer budget (158 tests green), and 1 was a real regression from this change, now fixed and registered.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible surface; the watch switch is off.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests and the bundle gate only. No daemon boot, no model calls, no live GitHub.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this is the wiring that turns a tested-but-unreachable subsystem into a reachable one, so its defects are latent until the switch is flipped. The guards are therefore treated as delivery guards: the allowed set, the Gone mapping, the release, the admission classification, the ledger's two acceptance checks, the off switch, the trust filter and the partial-coverage declaration each have their own mutation witness.
- **Evidence narrower than it could be, disclosed:** the serve-root glue — the dependency resolver's rebuild signature, the restore closure's option set, and the hook installation — has no dedicated test. It is verified by reading it and by the bundle gate, not by execution. The route seam's firing is likewise verified by reading: the existing route harnesses stop at validation failures and never reach a successful restore, and a test written against that harness was removed rather than landed because its "hook did not fire" assertions passed vacuously without the restore ever being called.
- **Known limitation, not fixed:** the allowed set's rebuild signature covers the hosted channel URLs but not the `gh` configuration hosts, so a host added to `gh` at runtime with no subsequent channel change is picked up only on restart. Fixing it means re-reading `hosts.yml` on every tick or adding another injected source; with the switch off this is disclosed rather than expanded.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Windows were not run locally and the PR CI profile skips those unit lanes. Configuration and turning the switch on remain a separate PR; the actions map is deliberately unprovisioned, and the drain's empty-map normalisation already treats an absent map as the generic prompt.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No wire shape, status code or public API changes.

Design (both languages, updated here): [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5c4bed1277c1a1db86d0b5cab12f40092d82ea90/docs/design/2026-11-09-daemon-pr-watch-enablement.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5c4bed1277c1a1db86d0b5cab12f40092d82ea90/docs/design/2026-11-09-daemon-pr-watch-enablement.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Follows #16847 (the listing write and carried keys) and #16810 (the shared restore core). Implements sections 2 and 4 of the enablement design; no issue is closed.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

daemon 的 PR 状态 watch 有两个声明了、但生产中从无填充方的依赖接缝，因此即使打开功能它既不能观测也不能投递。本 PR 把两者接上，并补上让投递从「最终会」变成「立刻」的那条路径。

观测与 drain 建立在**同一个 watch 目录与同一个锁 registry** 上，因此 owner 的进程内锁对每个文件都保持权威。允许主机集 = `github.com` + daemon 自己 `gh` 配置里的主机 + 本 daemon 托管的每个 GitHub channel 的 web origin——且只取 channel 分组已归属到**可信 workspace** 的那些组，因此不可信 workspace 的设置绝不可能扩大它。`gh` 读失败降级为集合的其余部分，绝不降级为空集（那会静默禁用每一次 view）。该集合在 hosted channel 变化时重算，而不是在启动时冻结。

唤醒休眠接收者时映射共享 restore 的类型化结果：Gone 集合映射为 `gone`，其余为 `unavailable`，其中写冲突**刻意**算临时——另一个进程可能随后释放它。成功唤醒交回一个 release，用于 detach restore 所铸造的 client：restore 只在失败时清理，而进程内唤醒没有 HTTP client 稍后替它做这件事，缺了它会话会留着幽灵 attachment、永不 idle-close。它只 detach 不 kill，因为 kill 会连带丢掉 drain 刚准入的那一轮。唤醒**共用路由的 session-id 准入实例**与它们的 live-conversation materialize 函数，因此不会覆盖路由持有的预约，也能恢复路由能恢复的同一批会话。

自推账本读接收者自己的 autofix watch 状态，**仅在仓库与 session 双双匹配时**接受。不可信 primary 根本得不到账本——查询在其检出里跑任何 git 之前就返回。任何拒绝都意味着无账本、于是转换照常投递：缺账本只会多投递，而不会压制一次真实的外部 head 变更。

最后，用户的 load 或 resume 现在会触发一个路由侧接缝，立刻 drain 该 workspace，而不必等下一个 tick。它跑在 refresh timer **自己的** drain state 上，因此能看到在途标记、不会重复投递；并且与周期 tick 受**同一个关闭开关**和**同一道信任过滤**门控。它的覆盖**刻意**声明为 partial：只扫一个 workspace，其他 workspace 的绑定都不在 rows 里，声明完整会让 drain 把它们的 watch 文件当无绑定删掉。

开关仍关闭，所以这里的东西在生产中还不会运行。

## 为什么需要

watch 的投递半边此前不可达：drain 存在且有测试，但没有任何生产代码提供它的依赖，而 resume 路径也没有办法请求投递。填充接缝是让本增量其余部分有意义的前提，而 resume 钩子消除的是「用户重开会话」到「看到其 PR 事件」之间的等待。

两者一起落地，因为填充提供了 resume 钩子所需的消费者。拆开每半都会造一个无人设置的接缝。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

从仓库根目录运行；每条命令自带进入包目录，并且必须清掉宿主的 serve 环境变量，否则套件假红：

```
cd packages/cli && env -u QWEN_CODE_SERVE -u QWEN_SERVE_MCP_BUDGET_MODE npx vitest run src/serve/server/ src/serve/fast-path.test.ts src/serve/run-qwen-serve.pr-watch-shutdown.test.ts
cd packages/cli && env -u QWEN_CODE_SERVE -u QWEN_SERVE_MCP_BUDGET_MODE npx vitest run src/serve/process-env-guard.test.ts --testTimeout=120000
```

第二条需要加长预算：该守卫遍历整个 serve 树、约需 16 秒，刚超本包默认 15 秒的 testTimeout，不加长会在负载下假红。

对这类改动最要紧的是**启动 bundle 闭包门**，因为新模块必须留在 pre-listen 静态闭包之外。它不是单元测试——它真的构建并打包，然后检查真实 metafile：

```
npm run check:serve-fast-path-bundle
```

本 head 上它报 `Startup bundle closure checks passed.`。

十八个变异，各被自己的用例击杀，只改日志措辞的对照存活。全部在本 head 上运行，源码逐字节还原：

| 接缝 | 变异 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| gh 主机 | 不加入允许集 | 仅允许集那条 |
| hosted origin | 不加入 | 仅允许集那条 |
| origin 形状 | 归一化 origin URL 而非其 hostname | 仅允许集那条 |
| `github.com` 种子 | 删除 | 仅允许集那条 |
| Gone 映射 | 关掉 | 仅 Gone 那条 |
| release | 不 detach 所铸造的 client | 仅 release 那条 |
| 准入分类 | 不是 channel turn | 仅准入那条 |
| 不可信 primary 守卫 | 删除 | 仅不跑 git 那条 |
| 账本 session 校验 | 删除 | 仅他会话那条 |
| 账本仓库校验 | 删除 | 仅他仓库那条 |
| scan partial 标志 | 丢掉 | 仅 scan 那条 |
| liveness | 恒真 | 两条 liveness |
| drain 锁 registry | drain 另建一个 | 两条 registry |
| 注入的锁 registry | 忽略 | 仅注入 registry 那条 |
| wake 前置条件 | 删除 | 仅 unavailable 那条 |
| resume drain 关闭开关 | 删除 | 仅开关关闭那条 |
| resume drain 信任过滤 | 删除 | 仅不可信 workspace 那条 |
| resume drain 覆盖 | 声明完整 | 仅孤儿 watch 文件那条 |
| 对照 | 只改措辞 | 全绿（15 通过） |

typecheck（`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli`）、ESLint 与 Prettier 均干净。

**验证面，明确说明：** 跑的是**整个 `src/serve/` 树**，而不只是新代码所在的目录——453 文件、19240 用例。这个广度是必要的：process-env 守卫住在 `serve/` 而非 `serve/server/`，正是它抓到了窄范围跑漏掉的一处未登记 `process.env` 访问。该树 15 条红中，10 条是本机全局 git pre-push 钩子拒绝临时 remote，4 条是负载超时（隔离 + 加长预算后 158 条全绿），1 条是本改动的真回归，现已修复并登记。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A —— 无用户可见表面；watch 开关关闭。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

仅单元测试与 bundle 门。不启动 daemon、无模型调用、不访问真实 GitHub。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：这是把一个「有测试但不可达」的子系统变成可达的接线，因此它的缺陷在开关翻开前都是潜伏的。守卫因此被当作**投递守卫**对待：允许集、Gone 映射、release、准入分类、账本的两处接受校验、关闭开关、信任过滤与 partial 覆盖声明，各有自己的变异见证。
- **证据层级比理想更窄，如实披露**：serve 根的 glue——依赖解析器的重建签名、restore 闭包的选项集、钩子安装——**没有专属测试**，靠阅读它与 bundle 门核实，而非执行。路由接缝的触发同样靠阅读核实：现有路由夹具都停在校验失败、从不到达成功的 restore，而针对该夹具写的一条测试被**删除而非落地**，因为它的「钩子未触发」断言在 restore 根本没被调用的情况下平凡成立。
- **已知限制，不修**：允许集的重建签名覆盖 hosted channel URL，但**不覆盖 `gh` 配置主机**，因此运行时新增到 `gh` 的主机、若此后没有任何 channel 变化，要等重启才纳入。修它需要每 tick 重读 `hosts.yml` 或再加一层注入来源；开关关闭下选择披露而非扩大改动。
- 未验证 / 不在范围：macOS 与 Windows 未在本机运行，PR 的 CI profile 也跳过这两条单元车道。配置与打开开关仍属另一个 PR；actions map 刻意不填充，drain 的空 map 归一化已把缺失的 map 当作通用 prompt。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。wire 形状、状态码与公共 API 均未变。

设计（双语，本 PR 内更新）：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5c4bed1277c1a1db86d0b5cab12f40092d82ea90/docs/design/2026-11-09-daemon-pr-watch-enablement.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/5c4bed1277c1a1db86d0b5cab12f40092d82ea90/docs/design/2026-11-09-daemon-pr-watch-enablement.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

承接 #16847（listing 写入与携带的键）与 #16810（共享 restore 核心）。实现启用设计的 §2 与 §4；不关闭任何 issue。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): ignore unchanged JSON todo snapshots
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Unchanged task-list results encoded as JSON now preserve the terminal's existing task panel and do not revive a task list from a previous user turn. They follow the same behavior as equivalent object results.

## Why it's needed

Task results can arrive as either objects or JSON strings. The object path already ignores an `unchanged` result, but the string path treated it as a new snapshot. Depending on conversation state, a no-op update could hide the current panel or restore stale tasks.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start with a visible task list and deliver an identical result marked `unchanged: true` as a JSON string. The panel should remain unchanged.
2. Exercise both pending and committed tool-result paths.
3. Begin a new user turn and deliver an unchanged result from the prior task list. The old list must not reappear. Equivalent object results should behave identically.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The independent fixture calls the actual sticky-task consumer with ACP-shaped JSON results. Before the fix, pending and committed unchanged results cleared the panel, while a result after a new user turn revived stale tasks. After the fix, all three JSON scenarios and their object controls pass. All 28 task-snapshot unit tests pass. Targeted ESLint and Prettier pass.

### Build validation

On a consolidated local validation branch containing this patch, the complete CLI type check and the official `DEV=true npm run bundle` command passed. The standard CLI package build hit this environment's memory limit and is not recorded as passing.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not run |
| Windows | Not run |
| Linux | 28 unit tests and actual consumer fixture passed |

### Environment

Node.js 24.22.1, Vitest 3.2.7, frozen workspace dependencies.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: JSON results explicitly marked unchanged no longer replace the current snapshot, matching existing object-result behavior.
- Not validated / out of scope: a live model conversation and terminal screenshots.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #8835, `todo-snapshot-string-branch-misses-unchanged-guard` in comment 5755846454.

prs.title: fix(cli): dispatch MCP commands with preceding global options
prs.body:
## What this PR does

MCP commands with a global option before the subcommand now run through the full CLI parser. Commands such as `qwen mcp --debug list` reach the intended operation. The fast path remains available for ordinary MCP commands and help, and preserves the argument separator.

## Why it's needed

The lightweight MCP parser does not register global options and assumes the subcommand immediately follows `mcp`. A leading option could therefore turn a requested operation into the parent help screen and still exit successfully. This was particularly misleading for commands expected to modify server settings.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run `qwen mcp --debug list` and confirm that the server list is displayed instead of parent help.
2. In an isolated configuration, run `qwen mcp --debug add --scope user example node`. Confirm a successful addition and the corresponding entry in settings.
3. Check ordinary MCP commands, `mcp --help`, and arguments after `--` to confirm the existing dispatch behavior.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The independent dispatch fixture previously reached neither the list handler nor the full parser; it printed help and exited successfully. After the change it invokes the full parser once and does not print parent help. Both MCP cases pass without changing that fixture. All 144 CLI bootstrap tests pass, including the argument-separator control. A real source CLI invocation with isolated configuration exited 0, printed the server-added confirmation, and persisted the expected stdio server entry. Targeted ESLint and Prettier pass.

### Build validation

On a consolidated local validation branch containing this patch, the complete CLI type check and the official `DEV=true npm run bundle` command passed. The standard CLI package build hit this environment's memory limit and is not recorded as passing. The generated `dist/cli.js` was then invoked with `mcp --debug add --scope user bundle-dispatch-fixture node`; it exited successfully and wrote the expected stdio server to isolated user settings.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not run |
| Windows | Not run |
| Linux | 144 package tests, independent dispatch fixture, and real CLI settings write passed |

### Environment

Node.js 24.22.1, Vitest 3.2.7, frozen workspace dependencies. The actual command used the TypeScript CLI entry point with tsx and a temporary configuration.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: commands with preceding options use the full bootstrap path and may start more slowly than the lightweight path.
- Not validated / out of scope: connecting to a live MCP server or model provider.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #8835, `mcp-fast-path-ignores-flags-before-subcommand` in comment 6569621892.

prs.title: fix(web-shell): mark the selected Full Access trigger as dangerous
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When Full Access (yolo) is the active approval mode, the composer's mode trigger now renders its icon and label in the destructive color, matching the treatment the picker already gives the option. The chevron stays neutral, hover keeps the warning color, and every other mode keeps the existing neutral styling.

## Why it's needed

The approval picker marks Full Access as dangerous, but once the mode was selected the trigger fell back to the same gray as the safe modes. The warning disappeared exactly when the riskiest mode became active, which is backwards: the trigger is the part that stays on screen.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open the web shell composer, click the approval-mode control, and pick Full Access (yolo). The trigger's shield icon and "Full Access" label should turn red (`--destructive`) while the chevron stays gray. Hover the trigger and confirm the red stays. Switch back to another mode and confirm the trigger returns to the neutral color. The new smoke test covers the same path end to end, and a unit test asserts the trigger only carries the danger class for yolo.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the trigger showed Full Access with the same neutral gray icon and text as the other modes. After: the active Full Access trigger shows the red shield icon and red label, verified in Chromium against a real computed color equal to the picker's `--destructive`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Local Vite dev server with the Playwright mock daemon; Chromium via the smoke suite, and Vitest in jsdom. `ChatEditor.test.tsx` passed 294/294, `tsc --noEmit` and ESLint are clean.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: visual only; the trigger now reads as a warning while yolo is active, including the icon-only compact layout.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows and Linux visual rendering.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #16874, which flagged Full Access inside the picker.

prs.title: fix(cli): preserve surfaced task selection across reordering
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Auto-surfaced approvals and explicitly selected tasks retain their identity when registry updates reorder the background-task list. In particular, a workflow approval that opens the list automatically stays selected when another task starts or finishes. Keyboard and explicit selection changes update the stored task identity.

## Why it's needed

The list previously remembered only a row number. Starting a newer run or completing an existing run can reorder the registry snapshot, moving another task into that row. The user could therefore land on an unrelated agent or workflow instead of the approval that opened the list.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Park a workflow approval so that the background-task list opens on its workflow.
2. Start a newer workflow, then finish another run that sorts above the selected workflow. The same approval's workflow should remain selected as its row moves.
3. Navigate with Up/Down and select a row explicitly. Later registry updates should preserve that chosen task.
4. Remove the selected task and confirm that the fallback selection remains within the current list.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The independent fixture uses the real provider and registry-subscription hook. Before the fix, inserting a newer run changed the selected task from the waiting workflow to an agent; completing another run changed it to a different workflow. An unchanged-order control passed. After the fix, all three cases pass without changing the fixture: the selected workflow moves from index 1 to 2, or 2 to 1, while retaining its identity. The package tests pass 10 provider cases and 142 dialog, pill, and view-hook cases. Added coverage also checks that cancellation dispatch targets the selected workflow after reordering, navigation changes the identity, and removing a selected task preserves the existing in-range fallback. Targeted ESLint and Prettier pass.

### Build validation

On a consolidated local validation branch containing this patch, the complete CLI type check and the official `DEV=true npm run bundle` command passed. The standard CLI package build hit this environment's memory limit and is not recorded as passing.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not run |
| Windows | Not run |
| Linux | 152 package tests and independent actual provider/hook fixture passed |

### Environment

Node.js 24.22.1, Vitest 3.2.7, jsdom/Ink fixtures and registry callbacks. No model or external provider is needed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an explicitly chosen task remains selected as its row moves, instead of keeping the same numerical row.
- Not validated / out of scope: live model/terminal E2E and the other #16444 follow-ups. The dismissed-approval reopening issue tracked by #17060 is separate.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; consumers continue to receive a valid row index. Approval handling and the auto-open keyboard acknowledgement remain unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Refs #16444, R1-6 only.

prs.body:
## What this PR does

The authentication dialog now uses the same one-second exit-confirmation window as the rest of the terminal UI for Ctrl+C and Ctrl+D.

## Why it's needed

The auth dialog shortened the confirmation window to half a second. Two presses that reliably exit from the normal screen could therefore silently restart confirmation during authentication, making it unnecessarily difficult to leave that dialog.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open the authentication dialog and press Ctrl+C twice, about 750 ms apart. The second press should quit.
2. Repeat with Ctrl+D and an empty input buffer.
3. Wait more than one second between presses. The second press must start a fresh confirmation rather than quit.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The independent fixture invokes the actual AppContainer keyboard callback with controlled elapsed time. Before the fix, the auth-dialog pair at 750 ms did not quit, while the normal-screen 750 ms and auth-dialog 300 ms controls did; the 1100 ms control did not quit. After the fix, the same four-case independent fixture passes. Four new package regressions cover both shortcuts at 750 ms and after expiry. The complete AppContainer suite passes all 289 tests. Targeted ESLint and Prettier pass.

### Build validation

On a consolidated local validation branch containing this patch, the complete CLI type check and the official `DEV=true npm run bundle` command passed. The standard CLI package build hit this environment's memory limit and is not recorded as passing.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not run |
| Windows | Not run |
| Linux | Actual component keyboard/timer fixture and 289 package tests passed |

### Environment

Node.js 24.22.1, Vitest 3.2.7, the existing AppContainer fixture, actual component state transitions and timer scheduling.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: authentication now allows the same confirmation interval as other exit paths.
- Not validated / out of scope: live authentication with an external provider and platform-specific terminal emulators.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #8835, `auth-dialog-ctrl-c-window-halved` in comment 6569621892.

认证对话框原先把确认窗口缩短为半秒。正常界面能够退出的两次按键，在认证期间却可能悄然重新开始确认，使离开该对话框变得困难。

## 评审测试计划

### 验证方法

prs.title: feat: add hybrid code mode
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Codex-aligned `tools.mode` enum with `direct`, `code_mode`, and `code_mode_only`. `code_mode` keeps ordinary tools directly callable while also exposing the isolated `exec` JavaScript tool; each visible ordinary tool carries its nested JavaScript declaration, while `exec` retains compact `ALL_TOOLS` metadata. `code_mode_only` preserves the strict exec-only ordinary-tool surface, and `direct` remains the default.

Updates filtered subagent tool surfaces so direct declarations and nested exec bindings honor the same allowlists, exposes the enum in Settings as Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only, regenerates the settings JSON schema, and removes the former `tools.codeModeOnly` boolean setting entirely.

Adds synchronized [English](docs/design/code-mode.md) and [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md) design documents, and brings the existing CodeModeOnly design up to the repository's bilingual documentation standard ([English](docs/design/code-mode-only.md), [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code previously offered only the default direct tool surface or the strict CodeModeOnly surface. Models could not combine direct calls for simple operations with `exec` orchestration for multi-tool workflows. A three-value enum matches Codex's `ToolMode` naming and gives users one explicit setting for all supported exposure modes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Leave `tools.mode` unset or set it to `direct`, restart Qwen Code, and confirm ordinary tools remain available while `exec` is absent.
2. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode`, restart, and confirm both ordinary tools and `exec` are available. Confirm ordinary tool descriptions include their `tools.<name>(args)` declaration and deferred tools remain discoverable through `tool_search`.
3. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode_only`, restart, and confirm ordinary tools are available through `exec` rather than as top-level calls, while direct control tools remain available.
4. Open Settings and confirm Tool Mode cycles among Default, Code Mode, and Code Mode Only. Confirm `tools.codeModeOnly` is no longer present in the settings schema.
5. Start with `--safe-mode` or `--bare` while either code mode is configured and confirm the effective mode is `direct`.

Automated verification completed: focused Core tests (121 tests), focused CLI tests (585 tests), a repeated settings-schema regression run (60 tests), full build, full typecheck, full lint, and both installed and branch-built CLI version smoke checks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: Settings exposed `Code Mode Only (Experimental)` as a boolean with `false` / `true`.

After: Settings exposes `Tool Mode (Experimental)` as an enum displaying Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only. Updated TUI snapshots cover the default display.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js v24.18.0; local source build and package-level Vitest suites.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Hybrid mode adds a short nested-call declaration to each ordinary tool description, increasing prompt size slightly; complete schemas are not duplicated in the `exec` description.
- Not validated / out of scope: Live-provider interactive runs and Windows/Linux local execution were not tested; CI covers supported platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `tools.codeModeOnly` is removed. Replace `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` with `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`.

## Linked Issues

Related to #10377.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增与 Codex 对齐的 `tools.mode` 枚举，支持 `direct`、`code_mode` 和 `code_mode_only`。`code_mode` 在保留普通工具直接调用能力的同时提供隔离的 `exec` JavaScript 工具；每个可见普通工具会携带自己的嵌套 JavaScript 声明，而 `exec` 保留精简的 `ALL_TOOLS` 元数据。`code_mode_only` 保持严格的普通工具仅经 `exec` 调用模式，`direct` 仍为默认值。

更新经过过滤的子智能体工具面，使直接声明和 `exec` 嵌套 binding 遵守同一组 allowlist；在设置界面中将该枚举显示为 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only；重新生成 settings JSON schema；并彻底移除原来的 `tools.codeModeOnly` 布尔设置。

新增同步的[英文](docs/design/code-mode.md)和[中文](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md)设计文档，并将现有 CodeModeOnly 设计补齐为仓库要求的双语文档（[英文](docs/design/code-mode-only.md)、[中文](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 此前只提供默认的直接工具面或严格的 CodeModeOnly 工具面。模型无法在简单操作中使用直接调用，同时在多工具工作流中使用 `exec` 编排。三值枚举与 Codex 的 `ToolMode` 命名一致，并为所有支持的暴露模式提供一个明确的统一设置项。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 不设置 `tools.mode` 或将其设为 `direct`，重启 Qwen Code，确认普通工具仍可用且不存在 `exec`。
2. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode` 并重启，确认普通工具和 `exec` 同时可用；确认普通工具描述包含各自的 `tools.<name>(args)` 声明，延迟工具仍可通过 `tool_search` 发现。
3. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode_only` 并重启，确认普通工具通过 `exec` 而不是顶层调用使用，同时直接控制工具仍然可用。
4. 打开设置界面，确认 Tool Mode 可在 Default、Code Mode 和 Code Mode Only 之间切换，并确认 settings schema 中不再存在 `tools.codeModeOnly`。
5. 配置任一 code mode 后用 `--safe-mode` 或 `--bare` 启动，确认有效模式为 `direct`。

已完成自动化验证：Core 相关测试（121 个）、CLI 相关测试（585 个）、再次运行的 settings schema 回归测试（60 个）、完整 build、完整 typecheck、完整 lint，以及已安装版本和分支构建版本的 CLI 版本 smoke 检查。

### 前后对比证据

之前：设置界面以 `false` / `true` 布尔值展示 `Code Mode Only (Experimental)`。

之后：设置界面以枚举展示 `Tool Mode (Experimental)`，可选 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only。更新后的 TUI snapshot 覆盖默认显示。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS、Node.js v24.18.0；本地源码构建和 package 级 Vitest 测试套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：混合模式会在每个普通工具描述中增加一段简短的嵌套调用声明，使 prompt 略微增大；完整 schema 不会在 `exec` 描述中重复。
- 未验证 / 范围外：未进行真实 provider 的交互式运行，也未在 Windows/Linux 本地执行；支持平台由 CI 覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：`tools.codeModeOnly` 已移除。请将 `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` 替换为 `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #10377。

prs.title: perf(java): share immutable transcript page snapshots
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps one deeply immutable event snapshot per Hosted Harness transcript page. `getEvents()` and the events member of `getRaw()` now share the parsed response instead of retaining separately copied maps and lists.

## Why it's needed

`JsonSupport.parseObject` already recursively freezes the response, and `getTranscript` extracts its immutable events list. The page constructor then recursively copied the entire response again while retaining the first events list. This duplicated the event containers for every retained page and repeated the traversal. The constructor is package-private and its only call site supplies that already immutable response.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Serve a transcript page containing nested event maps and content lists through the Hosted Harness HTTP route, then call the public Java client.
2. Confirm both accessors reference the same event list and nested events. Try to modify the raw root, either list view, an event map, its content list and a content map; each must reject mutation.
3. Confirm the session ID, cursor, event contents and `hasMore` value are unchanged.

The new HTTP regression fails on unchanged production because the page retains distinct event graphs. It passes with the fix. The full HostedHarnessClient test class, Java 11 release compilation, Checkstyle and formatting checks pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

An independent fixture uses a real loopback HTTP server and the public SDK with a 256-event page, matching the route's limit. It walks Map/List identities rather than estimating heap bytes or using a timing threshold.

| Observation | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unique event containers retained across both views | 2,050 | 1,025 |
| Containers shared by both views | 0 | 1,025 |
| Event contents | Equal | Equal |
| Nested mutation through either view | Rejected | Rejected |

This removes one copy of the event container graph. The counts are specific to the fixture and do not claim that total JVM heap usage is halved.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested |

### Environment

Temurin JDK 21.0.13+9, Maven 3.10.0, and the unchanged Java 11 release compilation target. Tests use controlled HTTP responses and the real SDK parser and page API.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the package-private constructor relies on its caller supplying the parser's deeply immutable snapshot. The HTTP regression covers that invariant, including nested maps and lists.
- Not validated / out of scope: no production heap or latency benchmark; no live model or managed service run. Earlier full TypeScript monorepo checks exited 137 in this environment; the affected Java checks passed.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no method signatures, serialized fields or pagination semantics change.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13313, R1-20, and its [original review finding](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/12654#discussion_r4143731464).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

让每个 Hosted Harness transcript 分页只保留一份深度不可变事件快照。`getEvents()` 与 `getRaw()` 中的 events 成员共享已经解析的响应，不再各自保留复制后的 Map 和 List。

## 为什么需要

`JsonSupport.parseObject` 已递归冻结响应，`getTranscript` 从中取得不可变事件列表。原分页构造器又递归复制整个响应，同时仍保留第一份事件列表，因此每个保留的分页都重复持有事件容器并多进行一次遍历。构造器仅在包内可见，其唯一调用点提供的正是已经不可变的响应。

## 审阅者验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 通过 Hosted Harness HTTP 路由提供带嵌套事件 Map 和内容 List 的分页，再调用公开 Java 客户端。
2. 确认两个访问器引用相同的事件列表及嵌套事件。尝试修改原始根 Map、两个列表视图、事件 Map、内容列表和内容 Map，均应拒绝修改。
3. 确认会话编号、游标、事件内容和 `hasMore` 不变。

新增 HTTP 回归在原生产代码上因保留两套独立事件对象图而失败，修复后通过。完整 HostedHarnessClient 测试类、Java 11 release 目标编译、Checkstyle 和格式检查通过。

### 修改前后证据

独立夹具使用真实回环 HTTP 服务、公开 SDK 和符合路由限制的 256 条事件分页。它按对象身份遍历 Map/List，没有估算堆字节数，也没有用计时阈值判定。

| 观测 | 修改前 | 修改后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 两个视图合计保留的独立事件容器 | 2,050 | 1,025 |
| 两个视图共享的容器 | 0 | 1,025 |
| 事件内容 | 相等 | 相等 |
| 通过任一视图修改嵌套内容 | 拒绝 | 拒绝 |

这消除了一份重复事件容器图。上述数量对应夹具数据，不代表整个 JVM 的堆占用减半。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境

Temurin JDK 21.0.13+9、Maven 3.10.0，保留 Java 11 release 编译目标。测试使用受控 HTTP 响应和真实 SDK 解析器及分页 API。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：包内构造器依赖调用方提供解析器生成的深度不可变快照。HTTP 回归覆盖该约束，包括嵌套 Map 和 List。
- 未验证或范围外：没有生产环境堆占用或延迟基准，也未运行真实模型或托管服务。此前 TypeScript 全仓检查在当前环境以 137 退出；受影响 Java 检查通过。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：无方法签名、序列化字段或分页语义变更。

## 关联问题

关联 #13313 的 R1-20 及其[原始审阅发现](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/12654#discussion_r4143731464)。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): serve PR watch deep links before authentication
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Opening or refreshing the PR watches page now serves the public Web Shell document before bearer authentication, consistently with the other page deep links. API requests, writes, and nested paths remain authenticated.

## Why it's needed

The client already places the PR watches page in the address bar, but the daemon omitted that page from its document-entry routes. A normal browser navigation cannot attach the daemon's bearer header, so reloading or sharing the page returned a 401 JSON response instead of the application.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. With a bearer-protected daemon, navigate directly to `/pr-watches` or refresh that page. Expect the shell HTML.
2. Check document GET and HEAD, including trailing-slash and case variations.
3. Request JSON, POST to the path, and request nested or encoded nested paths without a bearer token. They must remain unauthorized. An authorized API request should still work.

### Evidence (Before & After)

An independent real HTTP fixture uses the actual Express shell mounting and bearer-auth middleware. Before the change, three document navigation variants returned 401. After the change, they returned 200 with the expected HTML behavior. JSON, POST, nested-path and encoded-path controls remained 401, and an authorized API control remained 200. The same eight-case fixture passed without modification. Targeted ESLint and Prettier passed. Both package routing suites pass all 48 tests, including the added path's document and authentication controls.

### Build validation

On a consolidated local validation branch containing this patch, the complete CLI type check and the official `DEV=true npm run bundle` command passed. The standard CLI package build hit this environment's memory limit and is not recorded as passing. A real daemon started from the generated `dist/cli.js` with bearer authentication and built Web Shell assets also passed all eight document-routing and authenticated/unauthenticated HTTP controls.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not run |
| Windows | Not run |
| Linux | Real local HTTP routing fixture passed |

### Environment

Node.js 24.22.1, actual Express routing and bearer-auth middleware, local loopback HTTP, temporary shell assets.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this adds one public document entry route. The response is the existing public shell HTML.
- Not validated / out of scope: live-browser rendering and an authenticated model session.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; API authentication is preserved.

## Linked Issues

Refs #8835, `web-shell-pr-watches-not-pre-auth` in comment 6569621892.

## 为什么需要

prs.title: fix(web-shell): preserve observer activity during recovery
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keep an observer's running state and visible conversation while lost live activity is reconciled with a fresh snapshot of the same session. Ignore activity samples owned by another workspace or session.

Fresh inactive state ends the running indicator and takes precedence over older active responses. Recovery uses the existing load deadline and error handling, and an old failure cannot settle a newer session or a newly submitted local prompt.

## Why it's needed

During a long silent task, losing live-state coverage could finish the visible reply even though the task was still running. An SSE reconnect did not restore it, and a later active poll could restore the composer's busy state while leaving completed reply actions visible. This reproduces the observer idle-state path in the linked issue.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Attach an observer before another client starts a long, quiet task. Interrupt live-state polling and close/resume its SSE stream. The observer should retain its running state and should not show completed reply actions.
2. Restore live activity without emitting another assistant chunk. The reply should remain running. Complete the task and confirm that the composer and reply settle normally.
3. Delay recovery, then return an inactive snapshot or publish fresh inactive activity before an older active response. The task should settle and stay settled.
4. Fail or time out recovery, switch to another session, and submit a new local prompt during recovery. Confirm that load errors are visible and that an old failure cannot end unrelated work. Samples for a different workspace/session must not replace the current authority or add a full load to ordinary cursor resume.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Actual Chromium App reproduction with controlled daemon HTTP/SSE responses:

| Checkpoint | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Live-state coverage lost | Composer offers Send; completed reply actions appear | Cancel remains available; reply remains incomplete |
| SSE closes and resumes | Reply still appears completed | Running state and incomplete reply remain |
| Fresh matching active state returns | Composer becomes busy, but completed reply actions remain | Reply remains running without another business event |
| Actual terminal event | Composer and reply settle | Composer and reply settle |

The new regressions failed on the base implementation. All 1,167 focused tests across the affected provider, action, pane, and activity-bridge suites pass. Full build, repository typecheck, bundle, changed-file ESLint, and Prettier checks pass. A separate comment records the browser test method and its limits.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Build, typecheck, bundle, focused tests, lint, and Chromium reproduction |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.17.0, pnpm 11.24.0, and local Chromium. The real Web Shell App and activity bridge run against controlled daemon responses; this is not verification of the original hosted runtime or a real model call.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: losing previously known active coverage causes a same-session snapshot load. Normal successful polling and Last-Event-ID resume retain their existing behavior.
- Not validated / out of scope: the hosted gateway connection cap, runtime deployment, restart attribution, epoch-reset semantics, and reconnect-churn diagnostics.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no new public option or daemon protocol.

Design documents: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/51a9d1749be6f3c08665a93bbc7127f8cfb8ab24/docs/design/2026-11-13-web-shell-prompt-activity-recovery.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/51a9d1749be6f3c08665a93bbc7127f8cfb8ab24/docs/design/2026-11-13-web-shell-prompt-activity-recovery.zh-CN.md). Both versions cover the same decisions, constraints, and acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

Refs #17005 — addresses the reproduced observer idle-state path.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这项改动做了什么

实时活动状态丢失后，通过同一会话的新快照重新确认状态；等待期间保留观察者的运行指示与可见对话。忽略属于其他 workspace 或会话的活动采样。

新的 inactive 状态会结束运行指示，并优先于较旧的 active 响应。恢复复用现有加载期限与错误处理；旧请求失败不能结束后来切换的会话或新提交的本地任务。

## 为什么需要

长时间没有业务输出的任务执行期间，实时状态覆盖丢失可能让可见回复提前进入完成态，而任务仍在运行。SSE 重连不能恢复它，之后的 active 轮询虽能恢复输入区的忙碌状态，回复却仍显示完成态操作。这复现了关联 issue 中的观察者 idle 状态路径。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 先连接观察者，再由另一客户端发起长时间没有输出的任务。中断实时活动轮询并关闭、恢复 SSE。观察者应保留运行指示，回复不应出现完成态操作。
2. 恢复实时活动状态，期间不发送新的助手内容。回复应继续显示运行中；任务真正结束后，输入区与回复应正常结束。
3. 延迟恢复，随后返回 inactive 快照，或在旧 active 响应之前发布新的 inactive 活动状态。任务应结束，之后保持结束状态。
4. 让恢复失败或超时、切换到其他会话，并在恢复期间提交新的本地任务。确认加载错误可见，旧失败不会结束无关工作。其他 workspace/session 的采样不能替换当前可信状态，也不能使常规游标续传额外执行完整加载。

### 改动前后证据

使用真实 Chromium App 与可控的 daemon HTTP/SSE 响应复现：

| 检查点 | 修改前 | 修改后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 实时活动覆盖丢失 | 输入区显示发送；回复出现完成态操作 | 保留取消操作；回复保持未完成 |
| SSE 关闭并恢复 | 回复仍显示已完成 | 保留运行态与未完成的回复 |
| 匹配的 active 状态恢复 | 输入区恢复忙碌，但回复仍有完成态操作 | 无需新业务事件，回复仍显示运行中 |
| 真正的终止事件 | 输入区与回复正常结束 | 输入区与回复正常结束 |

新增回归在基线实现上失败。受影响的 Provider、action、面板和活动桥接测试共 1,167 项全部通过。完整构建、仓库类型检查、bundle、修改文件的 ESLint 与 Prettier 检查均通过。另附评论记录浏览器测试方法及其边界。

### 已验证系统

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 构建、类型检查、bundle、定向测试、lint 与 Chromium 复现 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地验证 |

### 环境（可选）

Node.js 22.17.0、pnpm 11.24.0 与本地 Chromium。真实 Web Shell App 与活动桥接使用可控的 daemon 响应；这不代表原托管运行时或真实模型调用已经验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：失去此前已知的 active 覆盖时，会加载一次同会话快照。正常成功的轮询与 Last-Event-ID 续传保持原有行为。
- 未验证或范围外：托管网关连接时长上限、运行时部署、重启归因、epoch 重置语义和重连抖动诊断。
- 兼容与迁移：无；不新增公开选项或 daemon 协议。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/51a9d1749be6f3c08665a93bbc7127f8cfb8ab24/docs/design/2026-11-13-web-shell-prompt-activity-recovery.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/51a9d1749be6f3c08665a93bbc7127f8cfb8ab24/docs/design/2026-11-13-web-shell-prompt-activity-recovery.zh-CN.md)。两版包含相同的决策、约束与验收标准。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #17005，处理已复现的观察者 idle 状态路径。

prs.title: feat(cli): run each OpenTUI round in one runAgentLoop call
prs.body:
## What this PR does

With `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` on, each OpenTUI round, its model request and its tool batch, now runs in one `runAgentLoop` call that returns after the batch, as headless and AgentCore run theirs. With `experimental.eventBusAgentLoop` also on, that call runs on the event-bus kernel, so OpenTUI is the third surface the kernel reaches. The turn still reads the round as an event stream, each event handed over only when the turn takes it, and still drives the turn between rounds; what changes is that the batch now runs inside the same loop call instead of beside it.

The batch starts right after the model round but runs no call until the turn hands it the executor over its scheduler, after the turn's own post-stream steps. A turn that leaves before then, because it was cancelled, replaced or closed by its consumer, closes the round, and the batch runs nothing, so the loop call always settles. A retried continuation admits the results it pairs into the replay bookkeeping right after the model round, the last point before the batch reads it. To hand the turn the round's calls and stop the moment the stream ends, the loop now passes them to `onRoundEnd`, on the procedural and the event-bus path. With the settings off, nothing changes.

This is OpenTUI's step 3 in #17045. The unified-loop design (EN and zh) describes it, and the `experimental.eventBusAgentLoop` description now says it applies to OpenTUI too.

## Why it's needed

#17045 moves every surface onto the event-bus kernel by having each round and its batch run inside `runAgentLoop`; the 11-19 checkpoint of #17045 waits on this PR. Until now OpenTUI called the shared model round and the shared batch separately, so the kernel, and anything attached to the loop later, did not reach its rounds.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Most of the OpenTUI test diff is re-indentation from `describe.each`; use "Hide whitespace" in the diff view.

- The equivalence suite of the event-bus loop gains a case: `onRoundEnd` gets the same calls and stop on both paths, for a round with calls and a round that stops.
- The round helper's tests run on the shared loop and on the kernel: events handed over one at a time, a retry's calls dropped, a loop stop reported, the stream closed when the turn stops reading, a model error rethrown, the batch run in one loop call on the executor the turn hands it, a replay answered without waiting for the executor, and the loop call settled when the turn closes the round after the stream or mid-stream.
- The shared-loop tests of the live turn run on the shared loop and on the kernel, and each checks that every round ran as one loop call with the matching kernel switch; the comparison with the current path checks that only the shared run used the loop.
- Mutations are each caught: the kernel switch not passed, the retry admission dropped, `close` not releasing the batch, replays not collected. Two stops in the first draft (a cancelled or replaced turn leaving the calls unrun) survived mutation because the turn already checks the same conditions and closes the round, so they were removed.
- The TUI parity suite runs each OpenTUI scenario a third time with both settings on and compares requests, side requests and the session record with the run on the shared loop; the debug log marks each round on the kernel and the count must equal the scenario's rounds. Every run pins `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_EVENT_BUS_AGENT_LOOP`. The suite on Ink is unchanged.

```
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core src/event-bus src/agents
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/opentui src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts
npm run bundle
QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=opentui QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run --root ./integration-tests ./interactive/tui-agent-loop-parity.test.ts
QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run --root ./integration-tests ./interactive/tui-agent-loop-parity.test.ts
```

Results: core core/event-bus/agents 9603 passed; CLI `src/ui/opentui` and the headless tests 3291 passed; the OpenTUI parity suite 20/20, each scenario on the current loop, the shared loop and the kernel; the Ink parity suite 24/24; root `npm run typecheck` and ESLint clean.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A: no visible change; with the settings on the parity suite compares the runs' requests and records.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Node 24, no sandbox; fake OpenAI server for the parity suites.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the batch now waits inside the loop call for the turn's executor, so every exit of the turn after the stream must close the round. The exits are the stream's own end or close, the steering events flushed after it, and the cancelled or replaced turn; each releases the batch, and the helper's tests cover the close after and during the stream on both paths. PR CI does not run the OpenTUI parity suite; it ran locally on all three arms.
- Not validated / out of scope: the turn's own driver between rounds stays; handing the whole turn to the loop is left to #17045's follow-up issue. Defaults stay off.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `onRoundEnd` gains a second argument that existing hosts ignore.

Design doc: [English](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #17045 (OpenTUI step 3). Follows #17059.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

开启 `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` 后，OpenTUI 的每一轮，即它的模型请求和工具批，在一次 `runAgentLoop` 调用中运行，调用在工具批之后返回，与 headless 和 AgentCore 相同。同时开启 `experimental.eventBusAgentLoop` 时，这次调用跑在事件总线内核上，因此 OpenTUI 是内核到达的第三个入口。轮次仍以事件流的形式读取这一轮，每个事件在轮次取走时才交出，轮与轮之间仍由轮次自己驱动；变化在于工具批现在在同一次 loop 调用中运行，而不是在它旁边。

工具批在模型轮之后立即开始，但要等轮次在完成自己的流后步骤之后，交出基于它的 scheduler 的 executor，才运行调用。轮次如果在此之前离开（被取消、被替换，或被消费方关闭），会关闭这一轮，工具批不运行任何调用，因此 loop 调用总能结束。重试的续发在模型轮之后立即把它配对的结果加入重放记账，这是工具批读取记账之前的最后一刻。为了让轮次在流结束时就拿到这一轮的调用和停止原因，loop 现在在过程式路径和事件总线路径上都把它们交给 `onRoundEnd`。设置关闭时没有任何变化。

这是 #17045 中 OpenTUI 的第 3 步。统一 loop 设计文档（中英文）描述了这一步，`experimental.eventBusAgentLoop` 的说明也写明对 OpenTUI 生效。

## 为什么需要

#17045 让每个入口的每一轮及其工具批都在 `runAgentLoop` 中运行，从而迁到事件总线内核上；#17045 的 11-19 检查点在等这个 PR。此前 OpenTUI 分开调用共享模型轮和共享工具批，所以内核以及以后挂在 loop 上的东西都到不了它的轮次。

## 审阅测试计划

### 如何验证

OpenTUI 测试的 diff 大多是 `describe.each` 带来的缩进变化，请在 diff 视图中选择 “Hide whitespace”。

- 事件总线 loop 的等价测试新增一个用例：对于有调用的一轮和停止的一轮，两条路径上的 `onRoundEnd` 拿到相同的调用和停止原因。
- 轮次辅助函数的测试在共享 loop 和内核上运行：事件逐个交出、丢弃被重试替换的调用、报告循环停止、轮次停止读取时关闭流、重新抛出模型错误、工具批在一次 loop 调用中用轮次交出的 executor 运行、重放无需等待 executor 即被应答，以及轮次在流结束后或流中途关闭这一轮时 loop 调用都能结束。
- 实时轮次的共享 loop 测试在共享 loop 和内核上运行，每个测试都检查每一轮都作为一次 loop 调用运行、内核开关一致；与当前路径的对比还检查只有共享那一次用了 loop。
- mutation 都被抓到：不传内核开关、去掉重试时的记账、`close` 不放行工具批、不收集重放。初稿中的两个停止条件（已取消或已被替换的轮次不运行调用）在 mutation 下没有被抓到，因为轮次本来就检查同样的条件并关闭这一轮，所以删掉了。
- TUI 对拍套件把每个 OpenTUI 场景在两个设置都开启时再跑一次，比较请求、旁路请求和会话记录与共享 loop 上的运行是否一致；调试日志会标出跑在内核上的每一轮，数量必须等于场景的轮数。每次运行都固定 `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_EVENT_BUS_AGENT_LOOP`。Ink 上的套件不变。

```
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core src/event-bus src/agents
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/opentui src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts
npm run bundle
QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=opentui QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run --root ./integration-tests ./interactive/tui-agent-loop-parity.test.ts
QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run --root ./integration-tests ./interactive/tui-agent-loop-parity.test.ts
```

结果：core 的 core/event-bus/agents 9603 个通过；CLI 的 `src/ui/opentui` 和 headless 测试 3291 个通过；OpenTUI 对拍套件 20/20，每个场景都在当前 loop、共享 loop 和内核上各跑一次；Ink 对拍套件 24/24；根目录 `npm run typecheck` 和 ESLint 通过。

### 前后对比

不适用：没有可见变化；设置开启时，对拍套件比较各次运行的请求和记录。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Node 24，无沙箱；对拍套件使用假的 OpenAI 服务器。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：工具批现在在 loop 调用中等待轮次的 executor，因此轮次在流之后的每一个出口都必须关闭这一轮。这些出口是：流自己结束或被关闭、流之后清空的 steering 事件、以及被取消或被替换的轮次；每一个都会放行工具批，辅助函数的测试在两条路径上覆盖了流之后和流中途的关闭。PR CI 不跑 OpenTUI 对拍套件，它已在本地三组上运行。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：轮与轮之间仍由轮次自己驱动；把整个轮次交给 loop 留给 #17045 的后续 issue。默认值仍为关闭。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。`onRoundEnd` 增加了第二个参数，现有宿主会忽略它。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

属于 #17045（OpenTUI 第 3 步）。接在 #17059 之后。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): retry memory content after refresh
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Refreshing the Web Shell memory panel retries the selected file's content read after the file list reloads. A successful complete read restores editing. Refreshing also preserves the latest view/edit mode, so cancelling an edit while a refresh is pending does not reopen the editor. A refresh that finishes after the user changes tabs cannot restore the previous tab, and a file removed during refresh no longer leaves the editor loading indefinitely.

## Why it's needed

After a transient read failure, the panel correctly becomes read-only, but refreshing an unchanged file path previously reloaded only its metadata. The content was never retried, so the panel could not recover after the underlying problem was resolved.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open a memory file and make its first content read fail. Confirm that editing is disabled.
2. Restore the read and refresh the panel without changing the file path. The content should appear and editing should become available.
3. Delay a refresh, switch tabs, then finish it. The previous tab must not reappear. A failed list refresh must keep the failed file read-only.
4. Start editing and refresh. Cancel either before the refreshed file list arrives or while the subsequent content read is pending. The refreshed content must appear in view mode, with the loading indicator cleared and no write performed. Without cancellation, the refreshed content should remain editable.

### Evidence (Before & After)

An independent component fixture observed one list reload but only one content read before the change; editing stayed disabled and recovered content was absent. With the change, the same fixture observed one list reload, two content reads, recovered content, and enabled editing. The follow-up at `12403efbde1565570ab8eb0e150344981a1cd63a` adds cancellation timing coverage. With the new cases applied to the previous head `c3d3bac`, 13 tests passed and the cancel-before-list case failed because the editor reopened. With the fix, all 14 component tests passed, including cancellation before and after the refreshed list arrives, refresh without cancellation, failed refresh, tab switching, file removal during a pending read, and existing replacement/CRLF controls. Targeted ESLint, Prettier, and Web Shell type checking passed on the follow-up.

### Build validation

Before this follow-up, on a consolidated local validation branch containing the original patch, the complete CLI type check and the official `DEV=true npm run bundle` command passed. The Web Shell type check and production build also passed. The standard CLI package build hit this environment's memory limit and is not recorded as passing.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not run |
| Windows | Not run |
| Linux | Component tests and type/lint checks passed |

### Environment

Node.js 24.22.1, Vitest 3.2.7, jsdom, frozen workspace dependencies.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an explicit refresh now performs an additional content read; a sequence guard prevents a stale refresh from changing a newer tab selection.
- Not validated / out of scope: live-browser screenshots and an authenticated daemon session. Other memory hardening items remain separate.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13207, item 4.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

刷新 Web Shell 内存面板时，在文件列表重新加载后重试当前文件的内容读取。成功取得完整内容后恢复编辑。刷新也会保留最新的查看或编辑状态，因此在刷新期间取消编辑不会重新打开编辑器。如果刷新完成前用户已切换标签页，不会恢复旧标签页；如果文件在刷新期间被删除，也不会让编辑器一直停留在加载状态。

## 为什么需要

短暂的读取失败会正确地让面板进入只读状态，但对路径未变化的文件进行刷新时，以前只重新加载元信息，不重试内容。即使底层问题已经解决，面板也无法恢复。

## 评审测试计划

### 验证方法

1. 打开一个内存文件，让首次内容读取失败，确认编辑被禁用。
2. 恢复读取，并在路径不变的情况下刷新面板。应显示文件内容并恢复编辑。
3. 延迟一次刷新，切换标签页后再完成刷新。旧标签页不应重新出现。如果文件列表刷新失败，读取失败的文件应继续保持只读。
4. 开始编辑并刷新，在刷新后的文件列表到达前或后续内容读取仍未完成时取消编辑。新内容应以查看模式显示，加载提示应消失，而且不执行写入。如果没有取消，刷新后的内容应保持可编辑。

### 前后证据

独立组件夹具在修改前观察到列表重载一次、内容读取仍为一次，编辑保持禁用且恢复后的内容未显示。修改后，同一夹具观察到列表重载一次、内容读取两次、内容恢复显示且允许编辑。后续提交 `12403efbde1565570ab8eb0e150344981a1cd63a` 增加了取消编辑的时序覆盖。将新增用例应用于原 head `c3d3bac` 时，13 项通过，列表到达前取消的用例失败，原因是编辑器被重新打开。修复后，14 项组件测试全部通过，覆盖列表到达前后取消、不取消时刷新、刷新失败、切换标签页、读取期间文件被删除以及原有的整体保存和 CRLF 控制。后续提交的定向 ESLint、Prettier 和 Web Shell 类型检查通过。

### 构建验证

在本次后续修改之前，包含原补丁的本地组合验证分支上，完整 CLI 类型检查及官方 `DEV=true npm run bundle` 命令通过。 Web Shell 类型检查及生产构建也已通过。 标准 CLI 包构建触及本环境的内存限制，因此未记录为通过。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | 未运行 |
| Windows | 未运行 |

prs.title: fix(sdk): release settled WebSocket probe deadlines
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Clears the actual WebSocket negotiation deadline when the probe settles. Successful connections and rejected probes now release their timeout immediately; a stalled probe still reaches the same deadline and falls back to the next transport.

## Why it's needed

The negotiation code created two timers but retained only the no-op timer's handle. The timer used by the race remained scheduled after a successful connection or an early rejection. This leaves a Node.js timer alive until the probe deadline, even if a short-lived SDK caller has already disposed its transport.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Negotiate with a daemon advertising WebSocket and ACP HTTP, and let the WebSocket probe succeed immediately. Confirm WebSocket is selected and no probe timer remains.
2. Reject the WebSocket probe before its deadline. Confirm it is disposed, ACP HTTP is selected, and no probe timer remains.
3. Leave the WebSocket probe pending. Confirm negotiation remains pending before the deadline, then disposes the probe and selects ACP HTTP at the deadline.

All 18 focused negotiation tests pass, including the three new success, rejection, and timeout cases. The SDK build, both SDK type-check configurations, ESLint, and formatting checks pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

An independent source-level reproduction calls the public negotiation function while tracking native Node.js timer handles and controlling the WebSocket probe response. The same script was run before and after the fix.

| Observation after successful probe | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Selected transport | acp-ws | acp-ws |
| Outstanding deadline timers | 1 | 0 |

The timing tests separately verify that a stalled probe still falls back at its configured deadline. The native-handle probe measures the retained resource directly; it does not claim an end-to-end process-exit benchmark.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested |

### Environment

Node.js v24.22.1 and Vitest 3.2.7. Source-level SDK reproduction with native timers, plus deterministic deadline tests with fake timers.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: deadline ownership changes, so tests cover both early settlement paths and actual expiry. The configured timeout and fallback order are unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: no browser WebSocket integration or process-exit timing benchmark. Full monorepo checks previously exited 137 in this environment; the affected SDK checks passed.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no API changes or migration.

## Linked Issues

Refs #8835, specifically [negotiate-ws-probe-timer-leak](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/8835#issuecomment-6569621892).

prs.title: feat(web-shell): commit only the selected files from the commit view
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Web Shell commit view can now commit a subset of the dirty files. It lists every uncommitted file with a checkbox, preselects all of them, and sends the selection with the commit. Unchecked files stay in the working tree, and work the user had already staged outside the selection stays staged instead of being swept in.

Underneath, the shared commit helper and the daemon commit route gained a `paths` option next to the existing `all` flag. The dialog no longer uses `all: true`; it always sends an explicit selection, and refuses to commit when nothing is selected instead of letting git fail on an empty pathspec.

Renames are handled explicitly: either half of a rename selects the pair, because git only records the rename when the deletion and the addition land in the same commit.

## Why it's needed

The commit view always committed everything. A single session that produced two unrelated changes (a bug fix and a refactor, say) could only be split into clean commits from a terminal, which defeats the point of having the dialog. The issue asks for per-file checkboxes so the Web Shell git workflow matches what the CLI already allows.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit and route tests cover the new behavior; no manual UI session was run. Reproduce the original gap by opening the commit view with two dirty files and pressing Commit — before this change both files are in the commit, after it only the checked ones are, and unchecking all of them surfaces a "select at least one file" error instead of a daemon call.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no screenshot or recording was captured for this run.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Tests and lint run locally on macOS from a linked worktree; no `npm run dev` session.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the dialog now depends on the diff listing to build a selection. If the list is empty or fails to load, it refuses to commit rather than falling back to committing everything, so a broken diff route blocks committing from the dialog (the CLI is unaffected).
- Not validated / out of scope: no manual UI verification on a running daemon, and no full `npm run build`. `packages/cli` typecheck was not run (fresh worktree reports unrelated TS6305 on unbuilt workspace dependencies); `packages/core` typecheck passes. `packages/web-shell` typecheck reports only the 12 known stale-SDK errors, which are identical on `origin/main`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `all: true` keeps its previous semantics.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #8446

prs.title: fix(acp): skip unusable transcript refreshes during active loads
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Returns the existing live replay when a paged session load encounters an active foreground turn, an admitted background turn, or a pending interaction. The eligibility check runs before every persisted-page read, including retries and traversal through empty pages. The existing checks after a read still protect against changed session identity, replay epoch and projection state.

## Why it's needed

An active session already has the replay that the client needs. Previously, each paged load still waited for up to two persisted transcript reads whose results were discarded because the turn was active. Two concurrent loads therefore issued four unnecessary reads and could remain blocked on storage or child-process latency. A turn that began during a read could also cause further unusable reads.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Keep a foreground prompt open, publish a visible live response, and issue two concurrent paged loads. Both should return the live replay without requesting persisted transcript pages.
2. Repeat with an admitted background-notification turn. The same behavior should hold even though no foreground prompt is active.
3. Start from an idle session and hold its first transcript-page reply. Start a foreground or background turn before releasing that reply. The load should return the new live replay without retrying or following an empty page's cursor.
4. Finish the work and load the idle session again. Persisted-page refresh should still occur and supply the fresh persisted content.

The six new regression cases fail on the unchanged base and pass with this patch. The focused bridge run passes 69 tests, including 63 existing refresh-related tests. The ACP bridge workspace build and typecheck pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

An independent script invokes the real bridge API through the repository's in-memory ACP channel, with deferred transcript replies and no model or network dependency.

| Checkpoint | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Two concurrent paged loads while the foreground prompt remains active | Two reads pending; four reads after both first replies are released | Both return live content with zero transcript RPCs |
| Persisted content returned for those active loads | None; both eventually use the live replay | None; live replay is immediately available without those reads |
| Idle-session control | Persisted refresh is supported | One transcript RPC and persisted content returned |

The before-script's 150 ms observation interval is an artificial fixture gate, not a production latency benchmark. The after-script confirms the loads finish while the prompt is still active and before any transcript reply is released.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested |

### Environment

Node.js v24.22.1 and Vitest 3.2.7. Independent bridge API reproduction plus focused unit regressions. No live daemon HTTP server, browser or model run is claimed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: active loads use the existing bounded live replay and its existing truncation metadata. Idle sessions retain persisted refresh, and pagination-anchor backfills remain a separate operation.
- Not validated / out of scope: this addresses Defect A's discarded active-session reads in #16368. It does not introduce cancellation of an already-running transcript RPC or coalesce independent idle refreshes. Defect B's event-ring retention was addressed separately by #16413. Full monorepo build/typecheck were previously attempted in this environment and exited 137; the affected workspace's checks passed.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no wire fields or API signatures change.

## Linked Issues

Refs #16368, Defect A.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

分页加载会话时，如果前台回合、已接纳的后台回合或待处理交互仍然活跃，就直接返回已有的实时回放。资格检查会在每一次持久化分页读取之前执行，包括重试及空页游标遍历。读取后的会话身份、回放 epoch 与投影状态检查继续防止竞态覆盖。

## 为什么需要

活动会话已经拥有客户端需要的回放。此前，每次分页加载仍会等待最多两次持久化记录读取，随后又因为回合活跃而丢弃读取结果。两次并发加载因此会发出四次无用读取，并受存储或子进程延迟阻塞。在读取过程中开始的新回合也可能继续触发无法使用的读取。

## 审阅者验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 保持一个前台 prompt 未结束，发布可见的实时响应，再发起两次并发分页加载。两次加载都应直接返回实时回放，不请求持久化记录页。
2. 改用已接纳的后台通知回合重复验证。即使没有活动前台 prompt，也应保持相同行为。
3. 从空闲会话开始，暂时阻塞第一次历史分页回复，在释放回复前启动前台或后台回合。加载应返回新的实时回放，不再重试，也不继续读取空页的后续游标。
4. 结束活动工作，再次加载空闲会话。此时仍应读取持久化分页并返回最新持久化内容。

新增的六项回归测试在未修改基线上全部失败，应用补丁后全部通过。定向 bridge 测试共通过 69 项，其中包括 63 项已有的刷新相关测试。ACP bridge 工作区构建和类型检查通过。

### 修改前后证据

独立脚本通过仓库现有的内存 ACP 通道调用真实 bridge API，使用可控的延迟历史分页回复，不依赖模型或网络。

| 检查点 | 修改前 | 修改后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 前台 prompt 保持活跃时，两次并发分页加载 | 两次读取等待；释放各自第一页后总计四次读取 | 两次直接返回实时内容，历史 RPC 为零 |
| 上述活动加载是否返回持久化内容 | 不返回；最终均使用实时回放 | 不返回；无需这些读取即可获得实时回放 |
| 空闲会话对照 | 支持持久化刷新 | 发出一次历史 RPC 并返回持久化内容 |

修改前脚本的 150 ms 观察窗口是人为控制的测试等待，不是生产环境延迟基准。修改后脚本确认：prompt 仍活跃、尚未释放任何历史分页回复时，两次加载已经完成。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境

Node.js v24.22.1、Vitest 3.2.7。验证包括独立 bridge API 复现和定向单元回归；未声称执行了真实 daemon HTTP 服务、浏览器或模型测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：活动加载使用现有、有界的实时回放及其截断元数据。空闲会话仍会刷新持久化记录，分页锚点回填仍是独立操作。
- 未验证或范围外：本次处理 #16368 缺陷 A 中最终会被丢弃的活动会话读取，不引入已发出历史 RPC 的取消机制，也不合并相互独立的空闲刷新。缺陷 B 的事件环内存保留已由 #16413 单独处理。此前尝试的全仓构建及类型检查在当前环境以 137 退出；受影响工作区的检查通过。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：不改变协议字段或 API 签名。

## 关联问题

关联 #16368 的缺陷 A。

prs.title: fix(core): treat `git remote show` as non-read-only (auto-mode egress bypass, #14359)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`git remote show` is classified read-only, so in `auto` mode it is auto-approved on the read-only fast path and never reaches the permission classifier. But it queries the remote over the network (`git-upload-pack`, i.e. `GET <url>/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack`) and accepts a raw URL argument, so it is a network side effect, not a local lookup.

This PR classifies every `git remote show` as not read-only, with or without `-n`. `git remote get-url` (which never connects) and a bare `git remote` keep their read-only classification.

The change is two lines of logic, one in each classifier: `evaluateGitSafety` in `shellAstParser.ts` (the AST path) and `evaluateGitRemoteArgs` in `shellReadOnlyChecker.ts` (the regex fallback, used when the WASM parser is unavailable).

Fixes #14359.

## Why there is no `-n` exception any more

Rounds 1 to 11 of this PR kept `git remote show -n` read-only, because `-n` stays offline. That needs proof that `-n` reaches git as an option, and neither classifier reads a command the way bash does. Each review round found another spelling where the classifier saw a `-n` that git never received:

| Round | Input | What git received |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | `git remote show <url> \-- -n` | `-n` after the terminator, as a remote name |
| 4 | `git remote show <url> [--][--] -n` | the glob expands to `--` |
| 6 | `git remote show <url> --end-of-options -n` | `-n` as a remote name |
| 8 | `git remote show <url> <<<-n` | no `-n` at all |
| 9 | `git remote show <url> \ -n` | one word, ` -n` |
| 10 | `bash -c 'git remote show origin' -n` (Monitor) | `-n` is `$0` |

All of these were already read-only at this PR's first commit. Each fix added a guard and the diff grew from 49 to 460 lines over ten files, and round 11 found a regression in one of the guards. The review itself asked whether the shape of the change was still right.

Asking about every `show` needs no proof, so the class cannot occur. The branch now takes every file it had changed from `main` and adds only the rule above: 4 files, +33/−2.

The cost is one approval for `git remote show -n <name>`, which was read-only before.

## Why deny-by-default (not a URL heuristic)

The original report suggested keying on whether the argument is "URL-shaped". Triage and maintainer review both flagged that an under-detecting heuristic (git accepts `scheme://…`, scp-like `user@host:path`, and local paths) would silently re-open the hole on any form it misses. Deny-by-default needs no URL parser and has no under-detection gap.

## Test plan

- `shellAstParser.test.ts`: `git remote show` classifies `unknown` for a remote name, a URL, with `-n`, after `-v`, and for the round 2, 6 and 9 spellings. The consistency table pins both classifiers to the same answer for `show`, `show -n`, `show <url> --end-of-options -n` and `get-url`.
- `shellReadOnlyChecker.test.ts`: `show`, `show -n`, and the round 4 and 8 spellings are not read-only.
- The new rows fail on `main` (16 failures) and pass with the change.
- Run locally: `shellAstParser`, `shellReadOnlyChecker`, `shell-utils`, `plan-mode-shell-policy`, `coreToolScheduler`, `tools/monitor`, `tools/shell` and all of `permissions/`: 23 files, 3,440 tests passed. `tsc --noEmit`, ESLint and Prettier are clean on the changed files.

## Risk & scope

- **`auto` mode:** every `git remote show` now goes to review (classifier or approval) instead of auto-running. `git remote -v` and `git remote get-url` are unaffected.
- **Plan mode:** the command is `unknown`, so a warning plus approval, not a hard block.
- **Memory-scoped agents** (`packages/core/src/memory/memory-scoped-agent-config.ts`) map the verdict as `isReadOnly ? 'allow' : 'deny'` with no approval surface, so `git remote show`, including `-n`, goes from allowed to denied there. That context already denies `git fetch`.
- **Not closed here (R11-3):** a redirection written between `remote` and `show` still classifies read-only on the AST path. The cause is not in the `git remote` rule: the parser ends the command at a mid-command redirection, so the words after it are not seen as arguments. That affects other subcommand rules on `main` too, and I am reporting it separately instead of widening this PR.
- **Reverted with the redesign:** the word-break guard, the here-string handling and the Monitor wrapper join from rounds 8 to 10 are no longer in this PR, so `shell-utils.ts` and the Monitor and plan-mode tests are unchanged from `main`. R11-1 and R11-2 were findings in that code.
- No change to allow/deny rule handling; no public API change.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14359

---

## 中文

### 这个 PR 做了什么

`git remote show` 被判为只读，所以在 `auto` 模式下走只读快速通道自动执行，不经过权限分类器。但它会通过网络查询远端（`git-upload-pack`），并且接受任意 URL 作为参数，所以它有网络副作用，不是本地查询。

这个 PR 把所有 `git remote show` 都判为非只读，不论有没有 `-n`。`git remote get-url`（从不联网）和不带子命令的 `git remote` 仍是只读。

逻辑改动只有两行，两个分类器各一处：`shellAstParser.ts` 的 `evaluateGitSafety`（语法树路径）和 `shellReadOnlyChecker.ts` 的 `evaluateGitRemoteArgs`（正则后备路径，WASM 解析器不可用时使用）。

### 为什么不再保留 `-n` 例外

第 1 到 11 轮一直让 `git remote show -n` 保持只读，因为 `-n` 不联网。这需要证明 `-n` 确实作为选项到达了 git，而两个分类器读命令的方式都和 bash 不一样。每一轮审查都找到一种新写法：分类器看到了 `-n`，git 却没收到。上面英文部分的表格列出了第 2、4、6、8、9、10 轮的六种输入。

这些输入在本 PR 的第一个提交上就已经被判为只读。每次修复加一条防护，改动从 49 行涨到 10 个文件 460 行，第 11 轮又在其中一条防护里找到了回归。审查本身也提出，应当由人判断这个改法的形状是否还对。

对所有 `show` 都要求确认，就不需要任何证明，这一类问题也就不会出现。现在这个分支把改过的文件全部恢复成 `main` 的版本，只加上面这条规则：4 个文件，+33/−2。

代价是 `git remote show -n <name>` 以前是只读，现在要确认一次。

### 为什么用默认拒绝（而非 URL 启发式）

最初的报告建议按参数"是否像 URL"来判断。分诊和维护者审查都指出，启发式一旦漏判（git 接受 `scheme://…`、类 scp 的 `user@host:path` 和本地路径），漏掉的形式会悄悄重新打开这个洞。默认拒绝不需要解析 URL，也没有漏判的问题。

### 测试

- `shellAstParser.test.ts`：远端名、URL、带 `-n`、`-v` 之后、以及第 2、6、9 轮的写法，`git remote show` 都判为 `unknown`。一致性表把两个分类器对 `show`、`show -n`、`show <url> --end-of-options -n` 和 `get-url` 的结果钉在一起。
- `shellReadOnlyChecker.test.ts`：`show`、`show -n` 以及第 4、8 轮的写法都不是只读。
- 新增的用例在 `main` 上失败（16 条），加上改动后通过。
- 本地运行：`shellAstParser`、`shellReadOnlyChecker`、`shell-utils`、`plan-mode-shell-policy`、`coreToolScheduler`、`tools/monitor`、`tools/shell` 以及整个 `permissions/`，共 23 个文件 3,440 个测试通过。改动文件的 `tsc --noEmit`、ESLint、Prettier 均无问题。

### 风险 / 范围

- **`auto` 模式：** 所有 `git remote show` 现在都进入审查（分类器或确认），不再自动执行。`git remote -v` 和 `git remote get-url` 不受影响。
- **Plan 模式：** 命令为 `unknown`，即警告加确认，不是硬拦截。
- **记忆范围的 agent**（`packages/core/src/memory/memory-scoped-agent-config.ts`）按 `isReadOnly ? 'allow' : 'deny'` 处理，没有确认环节，所以 `git remote show`（包括带 `-n`）在那里从允许变成拒绝。那个环境本来就拒绝 `git fetch`。
- **这里没有关闭的（R11-3）：** 在 `remote` 和 `show` 之间写一个重定向，语法树路径上仍判为只读。原因不在 `git remote` 这条规则里：解析器遇到命令中间的重定向就结束了命令，后面的词没有被当成参数。`main` 上其他按子命令判断的规则也受影响，我会单独报告，不在这个 PR 里扩大范围。
- **随重新设计一并撤回的：** 第 8 到 10 轮加的断词防护、here-string 处理和 Monitor 包装命令的拼接已不在这个 PR 里，所以 `shell-utils.ts` 以及 Monitor 和 Plan 模式的测试与 `main` 相同。R11-1 和 R11-2 是针对那些代码的意见。
- 不改变 allow/deny 规则的处理；没有公开 API 变化。
